title: 242 trapped by wildfire; pilots flew into flames to save them
summary_full: California National Guard crews performed a historic nighttime helicopter rescue during the Creek Fire.  They saved 242 people trapped by intense flames and thick smoke.  This extraordinary mission utilized night-vision goggles and combat helicopters in a wildfire zone.  The daring rescue demonstrated new possibilities for nighttime wildfire aviation response.  California has since expanded its nighttime aviation capabilities and interagency training.
